_comment: Temporary recrawl list (sitemap-retired.xml). URLs Google showed in search before they were retired, each now a 308 in vercel.json. Listing them with the retirement date as lastmod asks Google to recrawl them sooner and see the redirect (Google's site-move guidance). Written only until 'until'; never list a URL that is a built page.
source: Search Console query+page and page+date reports, 10 Aug to 10 Nov 2026
